name: mirage
text: Thanks. The engine that is running started at 18:23, before the key arrived. It still holds the old keys and BoltOdds is refusing them with 'Free plan'. I've asked for a clean restart, so the next engine run will read the new key. Once it's up I'll check what plan it reports and then make the one-socket, 3-league change. I'll report here with what it shows.
